facts.text: Through the Rural Health Opportunities Program (RHOP), students recruited from rural Nebraska receive free tuition at WSC and guaranteed admission to the University of Nebraska Medical Center (UNMC).

sources.title: Rural Health Opportunities Program (RHOP) - Wayne State College Nebraska
sources.quote: RHOP recruits students from rural Nebraska to become health care professionals. RHOP students receive free tuition at WSC and guaranteed admission to UNMC.
